steps.iphone_hint: Plug it into this computer with a cable and unlock it. The first time, tap Trust on the iPhone and enter its passcode.
steps.apple_id_hint: Cartouche is signed with it, as any app you install yourself. A free account is enough.
steps.install_hint: The newest Cartouche, with Increased Memory Limit, its certificate and the pairing file it needs.

install.release_failed: Cartouche's releases could not be read. Check this computer's internet connection.
install.installed: On this iPhone: Cartouche {{version}}. Your games and saves stay when you install it again.
install.not_installed: Cartouche is not on this iPhone yet.
install.needs_both: Plug in your iPhone and sign in first.

install.from_file: Install Cartouche from an IPA file…

apple_id.title: Apple Account
apple_id.enter_email_password: Enter the email and the password.
apple_id.two_factor_prompt: Enter the verification code Apple sent to your devices.
apple_id.max_certs_desc: Your Apple Account has as many development certificates as Apple allows. The installer will revoke them and make a new one: apps signed with them stop opening until they are installed again.
apple_id.no_keyring_available: This computer cannot keep the password: you will type it each time.

device.title: iPhone
device.no_devices_found_period: No iPhone found. Plug it in, unlock it, then press Refresh.
device.pairing_in_progress_hint: Unlock the iPhone and tap Trust, then enter its passcode if it asks.

operation.please_wait: Keep the iPhone plugged in and unlocked…

operations.install_success_message: On the iPhone, the first time only: in Settings › General › VPN & Device Management, trust your Apple Account; if iOS asks for it, turn on Developer Mode in Settings › Privacy & Security, and restart. Then open Cartouche: its setup already has the pairing file.
operations.install_step_install: Sign and install it, with Increased Memory Limit
operations.install_step_pairing: Put the pairing file in Cartouche

settings.reset_anisette_message: Reset the anisette state? Apple will ask for a two-factor code again.
settings.failed_reset_anisette_state: Unable to reset the anisette state
settings.delete_stored_rppairing_message: Delete the pairing this computer keeps for this iPhone? It will pair again, and the iPhone will ask to trust it.
settings.failed_delete_stored_rppairing: Unable to delete the stored pairing
settings.dont_use_keyring_message: The installer then keeps pairing records, anisette state and certificates in files on this computer, which is less safe. Turn this on only if the keychain does not work.

error.title: Something went wrong: {{msg}}

underage: Your Apple Account may be below the age Apple's developer services require.
account_locked: This usually comes after several failed sign-ins, and does no harm.
auth: Check the email and password, and try again even if they were right.
If it keeps failing, try another Apple Account.
Security keys are not supported: use an account with codes sent to your devices.
download: Check this computer's internet connection, then try again.
Download Cartouche-<version>.ipa from ((link:https://github.com/clabeuhtegrite/Cartouche/releases:Cartouche's releases)), then use Install Cartouche from an IPA file.
not_cartouche: Pick Cartouche's own IPA, Cartouche-<version>.ipa from ((link:https://github.com/clabeuhtegrite/Cartouche/releases:Cartouche's releases)). A game goes into Cartouche, with its Import.
cartouche_missing: Install Cartouche first, with the button of step 3.
house_arrest: [ios::26.3]Make sure the iPhone is not on a developer beta of iOS 26.3, which has a bug with house arrest.
pairing: Unplug and plug in the iPhone, then try again.
Make sure the iPhone has a passcode.
Connect the iPhone with a cable, not over Wi-Fi.
usbmuxd: [platform::windows]Install Apple Devices from the Microsoft Store, or ((link:https://apple.co/ms:iTunes)), and check that it sees the iPhone.
[platform::windows]If iTunes is installed, uninstall it with Apple Mobile Device Support, then install Apple Devices from the Microsoft Store.
[platform::linux]Make sure usbmuxd is installed and running.
trust: Unlock the iPhone, go to the home screen, and accept the Trust prompt.
device_coms: Make sure the iPhone is plugged into this computer.
Unplug it and plug it in again. If it keeps failing, try another USB port and cable.
not_logged_in: Sign in with your Apple Account first.
anisette: Pick another anisette server in Settings, and try a few.
Check that ((link:{{anisetteServerUrl}})) opens in a browser.
keyring: Turn on Don't use the keychain in Settings to get around it. It is less safe.
misc: Try again. Restarting the installer, the computer or the iPhone may help.
admin: Try running the installer as an administrator.
filesystem: Make sure the installer may read and write files on this computer.
not_enough_app_ids: Your Apple Account has no App ID left for Cartouche: a free account gets 10 a week.
App IDs expire 7 days after they were made, and cannot be deleted sooner. Try again then.
max_apps: A free Apple Account can have 3 apps of its own installed at a time, expired ones included.
Delete another app you installed yourself, then try again.

error.support_message: If it keeps failing, press Copy to clipboard and paste the error in a <issues>Cartouche issue</issues>.
